body: Merge-time refresh. This PR conflicts with main after the merge of #2260, in `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (the MCP and chat poll lines). The resolution needs a hand edit, so the class is DELTA. The PR is a draft again until the refresh is pushed and a delta review of the remerge-diff is clean.

Refresh: merge of `origin/main` (2360d879c) into this branch.

- New head: `c68d15e28deca666c139f640b0bd1d51be04ac87`.
- Reviewed head: `323bac95f`.
- Class: DELTA. One conflict hunk was resolved by hand.

Resolved hunk, `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `drain_actions`:

- This PR put the two `ai_chat.poll` calls and `mcp_host::pump` in the span `commands/mcp+chat`. Then it opened the span `commands/import+files`.
- Main (#2260) changed `self.ai_chat.poll(self.history.done_len())` to `self.ai_chat.poll(&mut self.history)` in the two calls.
- The resolution keeps the span lines of this PR and the two `poll(&mut self.history)` calls of main. No other line changed.

```rust
let s = span("commands/mcp+chat");
self.ai_chat.poll(&mut self.history);
// #183: an agent's live calls, after the user's own clicks.
crate::mcp_host::pump(self);
self.ai_chat.poll(&mut self.history);
drop(s);
let s = span("commands/import+files");
```

The PR has no other `done_len()` call with `ai_chat`.

Results on the new head (debug, `-j 6`):

- `cargo check -p camcraft-ui`: pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets`: pass, no warnings.
- `frame_cost::tests::spans_count_only_while_recording`: pass (ui lib).
- `frame_cost_probe::still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs`: pass (ui lib).
- `egui_app::tests::ai_chat` (basic, regressions, safety): 21 passed, 0 failed (ui lib).

<!-- pr-reviewer: c68d15e28deca666c139f640b0bd1d51be04ac87 -->
**Delta review: clean. The review at 323bac95f stays valid.**

Scope: the merge commit c68d15e28 (origin/main 2360d879c into the branch). `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2254 --reviewed 323bac95f` gives DELTA: one hunk in `crates/ui/src/state.rs` was resolved by hand. This is a read-only review. I did not build the code.

What I checked:
- `git show --remerge-diff c68d15e28`: the conflict is in `State::drain_actions`. The resolution keeps the two sides:
  - From main (#2260): the two `self.ai_chat.poll(&mut self.history)` calls, before and after `crate::mcp_host::pump(self)`.
  - From the PR: the `commands/mcp+chat` span around those calls, `drop(s)`, and the `commands/import+files` span.
  - The old `poll(self.history.done_len())` calls are gone. No caller of the old signature stays in `crates/ui/src`.
- The PR diff against its merge base (323bac95f) and the diff of the merged head against main (2360d879c) have the same changed lines. This applies to all 14 files and also to `state.rs` alone. Thus the merge drops nothing from the PR, and adds nothing from the PR side to main's code.
- No other file changed by hand.

The refresher reports: `cargo check` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui` are clean, the frame-cost pinning tests pass, and the 21 ai_chat tests pass. I did not run them again.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
